name: seafile-13
description: Official seafile community docker image. Seafile is an open source file sync&share solution designed for high reliability, performance and productivity. Sync, share and collaborate across devices and teams. Build your team's knowledge base with Seafile's built-in Wiki feature. ## Seafile 13 Upgrade Notes: - https://manual.seafile.com/13.0/upgrade/upgrade_notes_for_13.0.x/ ## Please see the Unraid installation guide I've written here before proceding. - https://github.com/chirmstream/Unraid-templates/blob/main/seafile-13/seafile-13_guide.md ## Please read the Seafile Admin Manual page for docker installation for further understanding of how seafile is setup. - https://manual.seafile.com/13.0/setup/setup_ce_by_docker/ Please note that the wiki feature of Seafile requires a seperate SeaDoc container.

variables.name: SEAFILE_SERVER_PROTOCOL
variables.description: If this is not set correctly you may have issues uploading files in the webui.

variables.name: JWT_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.description: JWT_PRIVATE_KEY, A random string with a length of no less than 32 characters is required for Seafile, which can be generated by using 'pwgen -s 40 1' on a linux machine.

variables.name: INIT_SEAFILE_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
variables.description: Root password of MySQL container. Only used on first deployment

variables.name: SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for MySQL database user 'seafile'.

variables.name: INIT_SEAFILE_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Initial Seafile admin username/email. Recommend you change this.

variables.name: SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_USER
variables.description: The user of MySQL (database - user can be found in conf/seafile.conf)
